snippet.title: Defense of the Oasis Gameplay Part1
snippet.description: Defense of the Oasis (also known as Oasis) is a turn-based strategy/puzzle game set in ancient Egypt developed by Mind Control Software. Oasis has been described as  Civilization meets Minesweeper.
